tts.comment: pcm_24000, never mp3. 128kbps MP3 produces coding artifacts on voiced speech that read as static (F12).
tts.comment2: stability 0.38 + style 0.35 gave lively reads but high run-to-run variance, and some draws came out with an audible noise floor (F13). 0.55/0 trades a little expressiveness for takes that are consistently clean.

pacing.comment: handoffGap is deliberately short — narration answering the clip immediately reads as a reply rather than a scene change. maxPauseSeconds trims dead air inside the clip the way a human editor would.

overlays.comment: No end card. A subscribe prompt at the tail costs the loop — a short that ends and restarts cleanly gets rewatches, and rewatch is worth more than the handful of subscribes an end card earns.
overlays.comment2: Film burns only at VO<->clip handoffs, never at every cut. The device marks a change of voice, not a change of shot; at 0.76 cuts/sec firing it on each one would be exhausting.

audio._: NO MUSIC BED — a standing channel constraint, not an open task. Do not add one, and do not treat its absence as a gap to close. The energy music would carry comes instead from diegetic b-roll ambience, tight pause cutting, and a denser vocal master.
